attributes.action: Implement the recommendations of the Rape Gang Inquiry
attributes.additional_details:
The independent Rape Gang Inquiry, established by Rupert Lowe, has presented a number of recommendations in its report to prevent the industrial rape and sexual exploitation of young white British girls.

We are calling on the Government to implement these recommendations as a matter of urgency.
attributes.background: To urgently implement the recommendations of the independent Rape Gang Inquiry, established by Rupert Lowe.

rejection.details:
We do not accept petitions which call on the Government to accept recommendations from an inquiry - which it hasn't itself established (statutorily or otherwise) or has a direct duty to respond to - when it isn't clear to the person reading the petition what those recommendations entail.

If you want to resubmit a petition calling for particular recommendations, spelled out in the text, to be accepted, then we can consider that.
